sources.title: Glencar begins piling for Pure DC LON01B2 West Cold Shell
sources.summary: Contractor reports piling underway for B2 West Cold Shell, with concurrent construction and fit-out across the live Brent Cross campus. The exact commencement day is not supplied; September 2 is the dated contemporary work report.

facts.power_scope: source says facility/campus capacity; IT-versus-utility not explicit in this report; not additive
facts.current_operational_scope: existing campus; does not establish B2 completion or operation

sources.title: Datum FRN2 construction progress
sources.summary: Operator reports FRN2 steel frame erected, stair steelwork and precast units nearly in place, architectural metalwork fitted and roof construction beginning. September 4 is a present-tense progress observation, not an invented groundbreak date.

facts.roof: construction beginning; shell completion not established

sources.title: Datum London and South East campus: FRN1 and adjacent FRN2
sources.summary: Operator locates its Farnborough facilities in Cody Technology Park and explicitly describes FRN2 as linked adjacent to FRN1. Its footer publishes the exact Google Maps campus link selected for the locator.

facts.address: Cody Technology Park, Farnborough, Hampshire GU14 0LX, United Kingdom
facts.hall_count_conflict: overview says two new halls; technical specification says four. No hall-count assertion selected.

sources.title: Datum-selected Google Maps campus feature
sources.publisher: Google Maps; campus link selected by Datum
sources.attribution: Google Maps; campus link selected by Datum
sources.summary: The exact Maps link published by Datum resolves to its named Datum Datacentres feature at -0.7967507,51.2803199. Feature coordinates are used, not the different viewport longitude. This is a parent-campus marker, not an FRN2 footprint.

facts.coordinate_pointer: redirect URL !8m2!3d51.2803199!4d-0.7967507; raw Maps response also gives feature coordinate pair

sources.title: Datum reports MP visit to ongoing FRN2 construction
sources.summary: The September 25 report says the MP visited the ongoing FRN2 construction last week and identifies FRN2 as the second facility on its Farnborough campus. The visit lacks an exact day; use September 4 for the precise physical observation rather than relabelling publication as visit date.

sources.title: Datum FRN2 planned technical specification
sources.summary: FRN2 is described as the next Farnborough development linked adjacent to FRN1, with 1,200 footprints across two floors and planned 22,000 square feet of technical space. The four-hall bullet conflicts with the overview’s two halls; retain the conflict and no inferred total MW.

facts.total_mw: not supplied and not derived from racks times density
facts.certification_scope: design/marketing claims on planned FRN2; achieved certification not independently verified

sources.title: 50Hertz begins Wustermark substation expansion
sources.summary: Utility reports current construction of the existing Wustermark grid substation expansion, explicitly supporting VIRTUS. This is upstream power-infrastructure work and does not establish a new physical stage at the data-centre buildings.

facts.exact_start_date: not stated; construction commenced as reported October 7

sources.title: 50Hertz Wustermark project page
sources.summary: Utility identifies the connected customer as VIRTUS Germany Holdco GmbH. Its undated project page gives 300 MVA, while the October 7 press release gives 300 MW. Retain both units without conversion or forced reconciliation.

facts.conflict: October 7 PDF gives 300 MW; this undated page says 300 MVA
facts.current_page_stage: page still describes planned start after approval; dated October 7 PDF supplies later actual upstream works

sources.title: Kao Data releases 2025–26 ESG report
sources.summary: Dated announcement publishes the new ESG report. Report availability is new evidence, but publication alone does not establish a new physical construction observation at Manchester.

sources.title: Kao Data ESG report page 7 portfolio overview
sources.summary: Report overview describes the Manchester facility as being developed, without a specific construction milestone or dated physical observation. It does not resolve the admission freshness hold.
